requirement: Props hold configuration only, never values or mutable screen/data borrows.
required_proof: No data-bearing FieldKind/Form props; single configuration helper with per-phase data.

requirement: Tab order is visible focusable field declaration order; Form never duplicates traversal with cx.focus.
required_proof: Tab and ShiftTab observe declared registration order.

requirement: Hidden fields register no ring/region and contribute no measure while eligible draft/cursor survives.
required_proof: Hide/show retains draft; hidden no geometry; later removal/type/sensitivity invalidation separately covered.

requirement: Field height is pure in FieldSpec, DesignTokens and width; update owns reveal using last-frame area, first-frame absent area documented.
required_proof: Same measured/drawn height both phases and first-layout reveal case.

requirement: FormAction carries only IDs/action keys; caller owns values; no values bundle crosses submit.
required_proof: Exhaustive action payload proof and no secret clone/serialize channel.

requirement: Form draw commits/cancels/validates nothing; blur commit occurs through FocusOut update.
required_proof: Draw state equality and FocusOut-driven commit test.

requirement: At most one semantic FormAction; declaration-first controls then action-row buttons; remaining outcomes preserve invalidation.
required_proof: Simultaneous actions resolve first deterministically without losing invalidation.

requirement: Nested Select popup owns its layer lifecycle, independent of draw order; Esc reaches control before outer layer.
required_proof: Nested popup closes before dialog; no deferred repaint or re-registration hack; apply later popover focus policy.

requirement: Form is layer-agnostic composition with decorative background, no own backdrop/frame/trap.
required_proof: Same Form under bare rect/Panel/Dialog; background does not produce UndeliveredIntent.

requirement: Submit commits active edit, validates visible fields in order, then cross-field rules; first error stored/revealed/focused; success emits submit action.
canonical_semantic_rows: A82; ADJ-12 resolves original every-visible wording against incomplete fail-fast implementation
required_proof: Every visible validator exactly once in order; all safe per-field errors stored; cross only after all pass; first invalid focus/reveal/action; two simultaneous oracle TablePro errors; hidden skip and per-kind commit policy

requirement: Enter submits only when focused control is neither swallowing typing nor editing; submit chord comes from Action declaration.
required_proof: Editing/nested input prevents accidental submit; CtrlS action binding route and hint agree.

requirement: Dirty changes on committed mutation or toggle/choice, not draft keystroke.
required_proof: Draft then cancel stays clean; commit and immediate value choice become dirty.

requirement: FormState/field drafts redact Debug and zeroize secret drafts before discard.
required_proof: Secret never appears in Debug/frame; close/cancel/removal lifecycle uses best-effort safe clearing.
